neighbours.label: Recalling something from memory: remember, recalled, 'did I mention', 'vividly'; the same frames with no memory stay low.
fire: She remembered that summer vividly, even after thirty years.
Oh, did I mention that the hotel has no heating?
I can't quite remember when we last spoke.
The old judge suddenly recalled that his guest was a lawyer.
He recalls the night of the fire vividly to this day.
Did I mention that the bridge is closed?
I still remember when this town had a cinema.
Anna suddenly remembered that she had left the oven on.
quiet: She painted that summer house carefully, even after thirty years.
Oh, look at how the hotel has no heating.
I can't quite reach the top shelf.
The old judge suddenly stood because his guest was a lawyer.
He reads the news of the fire aloud to this day.
Did you know that the bridge is closed?
I still drive through this town on my way.
Anna suddenly noticed that she had left the oven on.

notes: Probes: 'vividly' 1.09, 'did I mention' 1.02, 'remember when' 0.66, 'recalled that' 0.41, French souviens 0.22 at most; plain versions 0.01.
